screen-sharing.q: Will the teleprompter show up when I share my screen or tab in Google Meet?
screen-sharing.a: No. Whether you share a tab, a window or the whole screen, macOS excludes the prompter from the capture. Participants never see it.

extraFaqs.q: Do I need a Chrome extension?
extraFaqs.a: No. {{APP_NAME}} is a native Mac app and works with Meet in Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox without any extension.
Not if you place the window right under your camera and keep the font large. Your eye line stays on the lens.

extraFaqs.q: How do I use a teleprompter with Google Meet?
extraFaqs.a:
1. Launch {{APP_NAME}} and load your script from the clipboard.
  2. Position the transparent window next to your webcam.
  3. Join the Meet call; share your tab or screen if you need to.
  4. Speak naturally and let the script follow you.
